# White Massif Event Management

> White Massif is a corporate event management company based in Bangalore (Bengaluru), India, founded in 2013. It plans and produces corporate events end to end (concept, venue, production, AV, logistics and on-ground execution) for companies across India, with 1000+ events delivered for 175+ corporate clients.

- Founded: 2013, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
- Founders: Prakash A Vaswani, Vinay Kukreja, Hasan Peer H C, Naveen Abraham A
- Team: 35+ in-house event professionals
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 74112 72227
- Email: info@whitemassif.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST
- Corporate gifting arm: Massif Gifting Co.
